INSERT INTO pin (pin_id, user_id, title, description, image_url, link_url, created_at) VALUES (#{pinId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{linkUrl}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE pin SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE pin_id = #{pinId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.profile_img AS profile_image_url FROM pin p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.pin_id = #{pinId}
SELECT t.tag_name FROM pin_tag pt JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.pin_id = #{pinId} ORDER BY t.tag_name
